text:
Taylor L: Quick thread to close out the kv-eviction PM follow-ups. Need concrete owners for: regression job, incident-derived promptset, CI load test, and a 30-min chaos drill.
Ben C: I can own the regression harness. Plan: add a nightly job that runs a mixed read/write workload hitting TTL boundaries. Will open PR by Wednesday.
Rita P: I will curate the promptset from the incident logs. Target: 15 prompts including the truncation case and a few hallucination-triggering inputs. Will add expected outputs and a scoring note.
Devon H: I'll do the CI load test and add a smoke verification that checks eviction_rate and latency p95. Spiking today; PR tomorrow morning.
QA-bot: Note: include environment tagging so tests run against staging-inference and staging-routing clusters.
Taylor L: Also want an automated gate: if eviction_rate > 0.03 for 3 consecutive runs, create a ticket and @oncall.
Ben C: OK adding gate rule. We'll use metrics-exporter to compute eviction_rate over the run and fail the job.
Rita P: For promptset, should we include a golden-output that the eval job scores against? We observed soft-failures, so a thresholded bleu/consistency metric makes sense.
Devon H: Agreed. CI job snippet draft:
```bash
# run short cold-cache workload
./infra/tests/kv_cold_pressure.sh --keys 60000 --duration 240
# compute eviction rate
./infra/tests/compute_eviction_metric.py --output evict.json
if [ $(jq .eviction_rate evict.json) > 0.03 ]; then exit 2; fi
```
Taylor L: Good. Who will coordinate the chaos drill and the playbook? I want a 30-min window next Tuesday 15:00 UTC. Run through: simulate node OOM -> verify routing fallback -> validate degraded-quality alerts and rollback.
Rita P: I can help write the verification steps for degraded-quality alerts (examples + acceptance).
Devon H: I'll coordinate the simulation scripts and ensure we have a fast rollback plan.
QA-bot: ops-bot scheduled a drill placeholder for 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC. Please confirm participants.
ops-bot: Drill placeholder created: "kv-eviction short drill" on 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC. Participants: Taylor L, Ben C, Devon H, Rita P, oncall.
Taylor L: Action items summary:
- Ben: regression harness + nightly gate (PR Wed)
- Rita: promptset + golden outputs (PR Tue)
- Devon: CI load test + rollback doc (PR tomorrow)
- Taylor: update rollout policy in staging to ensure automatic routing fallback enabled
Please drop PR links here and tag if you need help.
Ben C: Will paste PR when ready.
Rita P: Putting TODOs in the promptset md and will link after PR.
Devon H: Spiking now, will post initial run logs to this thread.
Taylor L: Scheduling a 15-min sync after PRs land to validate integrations. If anyone hits a blocker, escalate here. :rocket:
